about_the_game:
Murder at Miller Farm!

Lily’s adoptive parents are brutally murdered in an isolated farmhouse. The young girl vanishes without a trace and is never heard from again—until years later, when witnesses claim to have seen her near the same farmhouse. Following these mysterious reports, a young journalist sets out to investigate the long-cold case. But the closer they get to the farmhouse, the darker and more disturbing the truth becomes.

Is Lily Dead or Alive?

What happened to Lily? Was she dead, murdered or kidnapped?

Traces of The Past!

The diary entries Lily left behind are eerie and deeply disturbing! Are they a cry for help or demonic vengeance?

Strange Sounds!

Whispers, screams and spooky strange sounds. I wonder what they mean.

Unexpected Truth?

Could what's happening on this farm be real? Or is everything an illusion?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 14393.102 or higher
  • Processor: Intel i5-2550K, 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970 / AMD RX 480 8GB or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 14393.102 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3770, 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970 or GeForce GTX 1060 | Radeon R9 290X or Radeon RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: Lily’s adoptive parents are brutally murdered, and she vanishes without a trace. Years later, after mysterious sightings, a journalist heads to the abandoned farmhouse where Lily was last seen to uncover the dark truth behind her disappearance.
